summation.displayName: Binding of the RUNX1:CBFB complex to the promoter of the PRK...
summation.text: Binding of the RUNX1:CBFB complex to the promoter of the PRKCQ gene, encoding Protein kinase C theta type, stimulates PRKCQ transcription. RUNX1 mutants associated with inherited thrombocytopenia are unable to transactivate the PRKCQ gene. PRKCQ is important for the functioning of megakaryocytes and platelets, but is not megakaryocyte specific (Jalagadugula et al. 2011).
